previous_disclosures.section: Risk Factors Summary > Risks Related to Our Business
previous_disclosures.summary: Winning semiconductor business requires a lengthy process and significant expense, which may generate no revenue.

Significant investments in research and development carry the risk of slow or unsuccessful returns, particularly in developing advanced technologies like custom AI accelerators and XPUs; failure to timely develop these or focus on non-adopted technologies could impair competitive position and negatively impact financial results.

current_disclosures.summary: Avago faces significant risks from the unpredictable and lengthy process of winning competitive design wins for custom AI accelerators and network switches, particularly given the substantial resource strain on both Avago and its contract manufacturers when executing multiple major wins simultaneously. To address customer constraints or competitive pressures, Avago may adopt new business models such as the sale or leasing of AI racks/systems based on XPUs, potentially offering alternative financings or deferred payment models. These strategies expose the company to additional costs, credit/default risks, reduced gross margins, and negative impacts on cash flow, while requiring significant R&D investment that, if unsuccessful or focused on non-widely adopted technologies, could impair its competitive position and revenue.

comparisons.peer_topic: Risks in New Product Development and AI Execution
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD faces intense competition and rapid technological change in the AI market, with significant risks related to developing, qualifying, and shipping new products on time. Delays can cause missed customer design windows, while uncertainty in long-term AI adoption and potential failure to achieve return on investment pose material risks. The company cannot guarantee success against competitors like Nvidia or customers developing internal solutions, and product complexity necessitates successful high-value launches to maintain average selling prices and competitive positioning.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and AMD disclose that significant investments in R&D for new technologies, particularly AI accelerators, carry the risk that development may be slow, unsuccessful, or not well-received by customers, potentially harming financial results. AVGO explicitly states that failure to develop ASICs/custom AI accelerators on time or focus on non-adopted technologies could impair competitive position, citing the risk of reduced demand for its AI products. Similarly, AMD acknowledges that while it makes substantial R&D investments, it cannot be certain that new products and technologies will be developed timely, implemented successfully, or well-received, which could adversely affect reputation and operating results. Both companies highlight the uncertainty of ROI in high-stakes AI product development.

sentences.text: Failure to successfully develop increasingly advanced technologies, including ASICs such as custom AI accelerators or XPUs and other AI-related products, could impair our competitive position.

If we fail to timely develop new and enhanced products and technologies, if we focus on technologies that do not become widely adopted, or if new competitive technologies that we do not support become widely accepted, demand for our products such as our custom AI accelerators or XPUs and other AI-related products may be reduced.

Although we make substantial investments in research and development, we cannot be certain that we will be able to develop, obtain or successfully implement new products and technologies on a timely basis or that they will be well-received by our customers.

We cannot be certain that our ongoing investments in new products and technologies will be successful, will meet our expectations and will not adversely affect our reputation, financial condition and operating results.

comparisons.peer_topic: New Market Competition and Investment Returns
comparisons.peer_summary: New businesses in AI, cloud-to-edge, and other areas introduce new competition and require significant investment with no guarantee of adequate returns. Failures in AI products or the foundry business could lead to asset impairments, restructuring charges, and opportunity costs.
comparisons.comparison: AVGO and INTC both identify the risk that significant investments in new technology areas (specifically AI) may not generate adequate returns if the company fails to develop leading products or if customers adopt competing technologies. AVGO warns that focusing on technologies that do not become widely adopted or failing to timely develop new products could reduce demand and negatively impact financial results. INTC similarly states that if it fails to develop leading products for AI workloads or if customers use competing technologies, it may not realize a return on its investments. Both disclosures emphasize the dependency of investment recovery on product leadership and market adoption.

sentences.text: If we fail to timely develop new and enhanced products and technologies, if we focus on technologies that do not become widely adopted, or if new competitive technologies that we do not support become widely accepted, demand for our products such as our custom AI accelerators or XPUs and other AI-related products may be reduced.
Increased investments in research and development, or slow or unsuccessful research and development efforts, would have a negative impact on our financial results.

These developing products and market segments require significant investment, do not always grow as projected or at all, or sometimes adopt competing technologies, and we may not realize an adequate return on our investments.

For example, AI and machine learning are increasingly driving innovations in technology, but if we fail to develop leading products for these workloads, or if our customers use competing technologies, we may not realize a return on our investments in these areas.

comparisons.peer_summary: Unsuccessful efforts to develop new memory and storage technologies and products could have a material adverse effect on the company's business, results of operations, or financial condition.
comparisons.comparison: AVGO and MU both disclose that unsuccessful efforts to develop new technologies and products could have a material adverse effect on business, results of operations, or financial condition. AVGO specifies that failure to develop advanced technologies like custom AI accelerators or XPUs could impair competitive position. MU states generally that unsuccessful efforts to develop new memory and storage technologies and products could materially adversely affect its business. Both highlight the existential risk that R&D failure directly impacts financial health and competitive standing.

comparisons.peer_topic: Risks of R&D investments in markets with limited history
comparisons.peer_summary: Investments in research and development for markets where NVIDIA has a limited operating history may not produce meaningful revenue for several years or at all, particularly if new products fail to obtain design wins or achieve widespread adoption.
comparisons.comparison: AVGO and NVDA both highlight the risk that R&D investments in specific product areas may not produce meaningful revenue or succeed if new products fail to obtain design wins or achieve widespread adoption. AVGO notes that if it fails to timely develop new products or focuses on technologies that are not widely adopted, demand for its AI accelerators may be reduced. NVDA states that investments in markets with limited history may not produce meaningful revenue, and failure to develop, monetize, or gain widespread adoption of new products could adversely affect financial results. Both underscore the critical nature of design wins and market adoption for validating R&D spend.

sentences.text: If we fail to timely develop new and enhanced products and technologies, if we focus on technologies that do not become widely adopted, or if new competitive technologies that we do not support become widely accepted, demand for our products such as our custom AI accelerators or XPUs and other AI-related products may be reduced.

The industries in which we compete are characterized by rapid technological change, new technological trends such as AI and cloud computing, changes in customer requirements, frequent new product introductions and enhancements, short product cycles, evolving industry standards and new delivery methods.
We have invested in research and development in markets where we have a limited operating history, which may not produce meaningful revenue for several years, if at all.
If we fail to develop or monetize new products and technologies, or if they do not become widely adopted, our financial results could be adversely affected.

comparisons.peer_topic: Risks in new product area investments and R&D failure
comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm's growth depends on extending technologies into new areas like automotive and IoT, but investments may not generate expected income, succeed due to patent/standard uncertainty, or yield returns due to underestimating costs, overestimating revenue, or long design cycles in regulated industries.
comparisons.comparison: AVGO and QCOM both disclose that significant investments in research and development, particularly when extending into new or expanded product areas and technologies, carry the risk that they may not generate expected operating income or meet expectations. AVGO mentions that increased R&D investments or slow/unsuccessful efforts would negatively impact financial results. QCOM states that investments in new/expanded product areas and technologies may not generate operating income or contribute to future results that meet expectations. While AVGO focuses on AI accelerators and QCOM on automotive/IoT, both share the core risk of R&D investment failure impacting financial performance.

sentences.text: Increased investments in research and development, or slow or unsuccessful research and development efforts, would have a negative impact on our financial results.
In order to remain competitive, we have made, and expect to continue to make, significant investments in research and development.

Our research, development and other investments in these new and expanded product areas, industries and applications, and related technologies and products, as well as in our existing technologies and products, and new technologies, may not generate operating income or contribute to future results of operations that meet our expectations.
